title.zh: Payments Giant Fiserv Launches Digital Asset Platform, With Bank of North Dakota
title.en: Payments Giant Fiserv Launches Digital Asset Platform, With Bank of North Dakota

current_state.zh: Fiserv's digital asset platform is now live with financial institution clients, debuting with Bank of North Dakota's USD-backed Roughrider Coin stablecoin issued by VersaBank on Solana with Fireblocks infrastructure, targeting access for more than 90 banks and credit unions through Fiserv's Commercial Center.
current_state.en: Fiserv's digital asset platform is now live with financial institution clients, debuting with Bank of North Dakota's USD-backed Roughrider Coin stablecoin issued by VersaBank on Solana with Fireblocks infrastructure, targeting access for more than 90 banks and credit unions through Fiserv's Commercial Center.
